chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him), which is from his sermon that includes mention of the great events (al-Malahim).

key_terms.الْمَلَاحِمِ: The great events or battles, specifically referring to the civil wars and conflicts in early Islamic history.

ai.seo_question: What is the Sermon of Al-Malahim in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the 'Sermon of the Great Events' (Khutbat al-Malahim), a pivotal discourse in Nahj al-Balagha where Imam Ali (AS) outlines the trajectory of Islamic history from the Prophet's era through the caliphates to the rise of the Mahdi. It serves as a theological framework for understanding the 'vicissitudes of time' (Tadawwul al-Zaman) as a divine mechanism for testing the faithful amidst political turmoil and spiritual decline.
